correctness.rationale: From all 169 frozen tetrahedra independently reconstructed f=(21,190,338,169) and 170-dimensional graph-cycle lattice. Computed a full-rank 170×170 facial-relation minor with exact determinant −125; full mod-5 rank 167 forces H1=(Z/5)^3. Computed annihilating mod-5 cocycles on all graph triangles: 984 cliques, 338 faces, 646 nonfaces, all nonfaces nonzero. Every one of the 31 lines of PG(2,5) occurs; 40/62 unoriented ±-classes occur, with 9 lines carrying both and 22 only one. Independently checked explicit order-three permutation preserves the facet set and induced action on homology classes, one fixed projective direction with 16 carriers, ten three-cycles with per-line totals 2,7,8,19,21,25,26,28,35,39.
